a.lede: Microsoft's latest Surface laptops dropped the Copilot+ PC branding despite hitting the minimum requirements. Even high-end AI devices like the Nvidia RTX Spark and Microsoft's own Project Zenith are noticeably missing the label.
a.title: Microsoft quietly drops Copilot+ branding from new laptops

b.lede: Microsoft's new Surface laptops forgo Copilot+ PC branding.
b.title: Microsoft stops insisting you need a "Copilot+ PC"
